price_class_legend.A: sportsbook price from a timestamped snapshot at pick time
price_class_legend.B: sportsbook price reconstructed from a pre-game snapshot, or stamped without a timestamp
price_class_legend.C: no sportsbook price (model's own fair odds, PrizePicks break-even) -- calibration only, not a betting ROI

note: Every row is a real surfaced pick settled against the real box score (the public ledger), replayed at its recorded payout. Class A/B rows were graded at a sportsbook price; class C rows at the model's own fair odds or the PrizePicks break-even -- calibration, not a betting ROI. MLB-PP is an unverified locks-history import. In-sample replay: filters are hindsight, not a forward guarantee.
